steps.title: Configure Pure Native Build Gradle
steps.description: Remove unnecessary third-party dependencies and configure Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2 with Java 8 compatibility.

steps.title: Define Cyber Styling & Color Palette
steps.description: Establish cyberpunk color palette and full-screen material window styling in XML resource files.

steps.title: Construct 3D Geometry and Shader Pipeline
steps.description: Implement 3D geometric mesh buffers, GLSL vertex/fragment shaders, and transformation matrices for OpenGL ES 2.0.

steps.title: Develop 3D Endless Runner OpenGL ES Renderer
steps.description: Build CyberRenderer implementing 3D camera projection, infinite neon synthwave grid, side buildings, and dynamic depth obstacles.

steps.title: Build CyberGLSurfaceView Touch Controller
steps.description: Create specialized GLSurfaceView managing renderer lifecycle, single and double jump physics, and user input handling.

steps.title: Synthesize Native Procedural Audio Engine
steps.description: Implement zero-dependency real-time audio synthesizer for jump impulses, 3D coin picks, and crash effects using AudioTrack.

steps.title: Implement High Score Persistence Engine
steps.description: Establish local storage leaderboard tracking top runs, collected cyber coins, and timestamps via SharedPreferences.

steps.title: Design 3D Heads-Up Display (HUD) Interface
steps.description: Create modern cyberpunk overlay layout featuring score, coins, speed gauge, and state banners.

steps.title: Create Hall of Fame Leaderboard Layout
steps.description: Build high-contrast neon ranking table with rank numbers, scores, coins, and reset capabilities.

steps.title: Integrate Main Game Controller Activity
steps.description: Wire GLSurfaceView, audio toggles, HUD updates, and activity lifecycle synchronization in MainActivity.

steps.title: Integrate Leaderboard Activity Controller
steps.description: Populate dynamic ranking items, date formatting, and clear record management in LeaderboardActivity.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest Declarations
steps.description: Declare hardware-accelerated activities, portrait orientations, and launcher intent filters.

steps.title: Building CyberRunner
steps.description: Compile, package, and verify the 3D CyberRunner release APK using Gradle 8.5.
